model.title: Make a water cycle in a bowl

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: Adult pours warm water into a bowl

parts.label: Step 4
parts.text: Wait 10 minutes and look under the film

parts.label: Answer
parts.text: Drops condense under the cold film and drip back down

questions.q: What turns water into water vapour?
questions.model: The Sun shines on the sea. The water gets warm. It turns into vapour and rises. This is evaporation.

questions.q: Draw and label the water cycle diagram: sea, Sun, clouds, rain, mountain, river, with the four stages and arrows.
questions.a: A labelled cycle with evaporation, condensation, precipitation and collection in the right places
questions.model: Teacher draws the sea and the first arrow for evaporation.

questions.q: Write what happened in the bowl demo using two key words.
questions.a: Warm water evaporated; the vapour condensed on the cold film and dripped back down

questions.q: Why does it rain more over mountains?
questions.a: Air rises over mountains and cools, so vapour condenses and rain falls

questions.q: Big question: could your water have been in a cloud?
questions.a: Yes: the same water goes round the cycle from sea to cloud to rain to river
